settings.editor: Have questions? We’ve answered some of the most common things people ask about our errand services below.

What areas do you serve?

settings.editor: Eazy Errands provides concierge, errand, transportation, grocery shopping, home support, senior assistance, vacation home visits, lifestyle support services, and more throughout Florida’s Treasure Coast.
We proudly serve Port St. Lucie, Stuart, Jupiter, Jensen Beach, Palm City, Fort Pierce, and surrounding Treasure Coast communities.
Yes. Eazy Errands provides non-medical concierge, transportation, and lifestyle support services only.
Absolutely. Every client has unique needs, and we are happy to create personalized concierge and lifestyle support service plans.

Eazy Errands combines concierge services, errands, transportation, home support, senior assistance, and vacation property services into one trusted and dependable lifestyle support company designed to make everyday life easier. 
Our goal is to simplify everyday life by providing reliable, convenient, and personalized support throughout Florida’s Treasure Coast.
